user.title: E-bike tracker
user.description: The device id must match CONFIG_EBIKE_DEVICE_ID in the firmware and the device id in the server config. This integration subscribes to ebike/v1/<device_id>/state over Home Assistant's existing MQTT connection.

data_description.device_id: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 1-32 characters
data_description.coord_system: Use GCJ-02 for Chinese map tiles (AMap/Tencent), WGS84 for OSM

error.invalid_device_id: Device id must be 1-32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens

abort.mqtt_required: Configure the Home Assistant MQTT integration first (broker address, the 'ha' account credentials, and the ca.crt generated by the server)
